description: JANAVI (Papermark fork) API surface — route groups, auth model, licensing boundary. Maintained per sprint; update after modifying API routes.

auth_models.session: NextAuth getServerSession (JWT strategy) + UserTeam membership check; newer routes use withTeam/withTeamApi (lib/api/auth/with-session-team.ts) with RBAC (lib/api/rbac/permissions.ts: ADMIN/MANAGER/MEMBER/DATAROOM_MEMBER)
auth_models.internal: INTERNAL_API_KEY Bearer — mupdf workers, /api/jobs/*, S3 presign get-url
auth_models.public_viewer: Link resolution via fetchLinkDataById (no secrets client-side; password sanitized to 'protected'); access gate POST /api/views | /api/views-dataroom; Redis-backed link/dataroom session cookies (pm_ls_<linkId>, pm_drs_<linkId>) with browser fingerprint + rate limits
auth_models.token: HMAC action tokens (agreements pm_sas_*, download pm_sds, unsubscribe), OTP VerificationToken rows, 23h hashed link-verification tokens
auth_models.api_key: Legacy deprecated public API: hashed RestrictedToken Bearer (pages/api/webhooks/services)

routes: POST / accepts optional agreementType (NDA|MSA|SOW|SLA|PARTNERSHIP|VENDOR|EMPLOYMENT|OTHER → agreementStatus DRAFT); PATCH /:id accepts agreementType/agreementStatus/agreementMeta; GET / supports ?agreementType= filter and search matches name OR agreementType (2026-10-20)
POST / (create; password AES-256-CTR encrypted at pages/api/links/index.ts:182)
PUT/DELETE /:id (PUT returns decrypted password to owners)

POST / for agreement-categorized documents layers Confidential defaults onto the request body when toggles are omitted: emailProtected+emailAuthenticated, allowDownload=false, tiled '{{email}} · {{date}} · CONFIDENTIAL' watermark (2026-10-20)

enforcement_order: link exists / not archived / not deleted / not expired
emailAuthenticated → 6-digit OTP (10min) then 23h hashed verification token (lib/api/auth/token.ts)
on success: create Viewer+View, sign ±5-page window URLs, set link-session cookie (23h, fingerprint-bound, 100req/min)

route_groups.notes: same gates plus ViewerGroupAccessControls.canView/canDownload and PermissionGroupAccessControls; effective canDownload computed server-side; sets pm_drs_* cookies

route_groups.auth: link/dataroom session or owner previewToken; view age <23h
route_groups.notes: lazy re-signing of page image URLs, 60/min rate limit

route_groups.auth: public — CRITICAL: serves original file bytes
checks: view age: 30min document links / 23h dataroom links
route_groups.watermark: if enableWatermark + pdf/image → server-flattened watermarked PDF via /api/mupdf/annotate-document (INTERNAL_API_KEY)

routes: settings, members, invitations, domains, branding, brands(/default), tokens (API keys), webhooks, tags, presets, viewer-groups, export-jobs, notifications/preferences, limits, global-block-list
record_view, record_click, record_video_view, record_reaction, report (abuse), feedback

route_groups.session_strategy: JWT (CustomUser embedded, refreshed on update trigger)

ee_licensed_boundaries.rule: Never re-import or recreate these trees; JANAVI equivalents live in lib/janavi, lib/branding, components/branding, lib/request-lists, components/conversations, components/view/confidential

gaps_vs_janavi_requirements.max_view_count: ABSENT — no Link field, no enforcement
gaps_vs_janavi_requirements.watermark_viewing: client-side SVG overlay only (components/view/watermark-svg.tsx); server-side flattening exists only for downloads
gaps_vs_janavi_requirements.session_max_duration: partial — fixed 23h sessions; no owner-configurable duration
gaps_vs_janavi_requirements.session_revocation: viewer_sessions:<viewerId> Redis set exists (immediate revocation possible); no UI/policy

removed_routes: billing (stripe webhooks, settings/billing, internal/billing), workflows pages+api, conversations shims+faqs, dataroom trial, dataroom-invitations (invite modals), questions route reimplemented flag-gated, /api/jobs/send-conversation-* + send-pause-resume-notification
